author: okstays
description: Hotels ranked by real comfort, not commission.
name: OKstays

prompts.name: find_hotel
prompts.title: Find a comfortable hotel
prompts.description: Hotels in a destination ranked by comfort for what matters to you, with links that book your dates.

arguments.name: destination
arguments.description: City or island, e.g. Lisbon or Bali

arguments.name: what_matters
arguments.description: e.g. quiet nights, a great bed, fast WiFi, near the beach

arguments.name: budget
arguments.description: Highest price per night, e.g. US$150

arguments.name: dates
arguments.description: Check-in and check-out, e.g. 12 to 15 March 2027

prompts.name: plan_my_trip
prompts.title: Plan a multi-stop trip
prompts.description: One hotel per stop for a trip through several destinations, dated back to back, with an indicative total.

arguments.name: stops
arguments.description: Destinations and nights in order, e.g. Lisbon 4 nights, Porto 3, Madrid 5

arguments.name: travel_style
arguments.description: e.g. couples, families, remote work, deep sleep

arguments.name: budget
arguments.description: Highest price per night, e.g. US$200

prompts.name: compare_my_hotels
prompts.title: Compare hotels
prompts.description: Two to four hotels you're considering, side by side: comfort, what guests complain about, price and a verdict.

arguments.name: hotels
arguments.description: Hotel names, e.g. Pestana Palace, Memmo Alfama

prompts.name: choose_area
prompts.title: Choose where to stay
prompts.description: The best areas of a destination for comfort, with their prices and top hotels.

arguments.name: what_matters
arguments.description: e.g. quiet, walkable, near the beach, nightlife

resources.name: hotel_cards
resources.title: OKstays hotel cards
resources.description: Hotel cards with photo, Comfort Score, price and a link to the hotel's OKstays page.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Rank hotels in a city by the OKstays Comfort Score (0-10 from comfort signals; cleanliness, beds, shower, bugs and safety count 40%). Only hotels that pass all five must-haves are returned. Optionally rank for a travel style (persona) and/or require specific strengths. Returns up to 10 hotels per page (limit, page) with strengths, caveats, price and links. To check a hotel the user already has in mind, pass hotel_name. Pass the user's dates and guests (checkin, checkout, adults) when known.

location.description: City name or slug, e.g. 'Barcelona' or 'new-york'. Use list_cities for coverage.

persona.description: Travel style to rank for: digital-nomad, deep-sleep, avoid-crowds, romantic, family, business, solo-safe, luxury, budget-comfort.

tags.description: Filter ids the hotel must score 8+ on, e.g. ['soundproofing', 'reliable_wifi']; their names work too ('quiet'). See get_filters.

max_price.description: Maximum indicative price per night in USD.

district.description: Neighbourhood to restrict to, e.g. 'Gothic Quarter'. get_city_overview lists the districts; another area name is matched against hotel addresses.

near_lat.description: Latitude of a landmark or address the user names (not the user's own location); with near_lng restricts results to hotels within radius_km and reports distance_km.

near_lng.description: Longitude of the point of interest.

radius_km.description: Search radius around near_lat/near_lng in km (default 3).

sort_by.description: best = Comfort Score (default); value = Comfort Score per $100; nearest needs near_lat/near_lng.

hotel_name.description: Find a hotel by name in this city (part of the name works, e.g. 'Pestana'), including hotels outside our rankings; the other filters are then ignored.

page.description: Page of results (default 1; up to 5) for 'show me more'.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, if given: links then open on this stay.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: One hotel in depth: Comfort Score breakdown, what the scores rest on, the five must-haves, its strengths and complaints with the reason behind each score, price and links. Pass focus with what the user asked about; detail='full' adds every scored signal (about four times longer).

focus.description: Signals the user asked about, as filter ids or names (e.g. ['quiet', 'bed', 'wifi']); always included with their reasons.

detail.description: summary (default) or full: every scored signal with its explanation, about four times longer.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, if given: links then open on this stay.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Destinations covered, with hotel counts. Optionally only those in one country.

country.description: Country name to filter by, e.g. 'Spain'.

tools.name: get_filters
tools.description: All comfort filters (ids, names, descriptions, categories) usable in search_hotels, plus the travel styles (personas).

tools.name: compare_hotels
tools.description: Compare 2-4 hotels side by side: Comfort Score breakdown, price, strengths, caveats, the filters where they differ most, and a verdict (best comfort, cheapest, best value).

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, if given: links then open on this stay.

tools.name: find_similar_hotels
tools.description: Hotels in the same city with the comfort profile closest to a given hotel (similar scores across the comfort filters). Use cheaper_only for 'like this one but cheaper'.

hotel_id.description: Hotel id to find alternatives for.

cheaper_only.description: Only hotels priced below this one.

max_price.description: Maximum price per night in USD.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, if given: links then open on this stay.

tools.name: get_city_overview
tools.description: Snapshot of a destination: hotel counts, average Comfort Score, median price, where its hotels beat and trail the average hotel, the best neighbourhoods, and which travel styles it suits. Use it when the user is choosing a destination or an area; for a request for hotels (e.g. 'quiet hotels in Bangkok'), call search_hotels directly.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, if given: links then open on this stay.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Hotels for a multi-stop trip, one stay per destination in travel order (e.g. Lisbon 4 nights, Porto 3, Madrid 5): the best match for each stop by the OKstays Comfort Score (or the travel style's score), alternatives, the stay dates and an indicative total. Each hotel link opens its OKstays page with the stop's dates, so its Book Now button books those nights. Agree the stops and nights with the user first; list_cities shows which destinations of a country we cover.

location.description: City name or slug, as in search_hotels.

start_date.description: Check-in date of the first stop, YYYY-MM-DD; each stop starts when the one before ends. Without it, no dates are set.

persona.description: Travel style for every stop: digital-nomad, deep-sleep, avoid-crowds, romantic, family, business, solo-safe, luxury, budget-comfort.

tags.description: Filters every hotel must score 8+ on, as in search_hotels.

max_price.description: Maximum indicative price per night in USD.
